posts.message: Aug 2025 - Ishaanth's Media Day.  Thank you ABC for covering this great project.

Nov 2021 Through July 2022 - Jackson Davis Eagle Project work days.  

04-20-21 - Presentation to Pasco School Board.
07-21-21 - First BN9 Interview.
10-22-21 - Pick up the bus and deliver to K-Tech.
11-06-21 - 1st offical workday.  Remove the seats.
12-23-31 - Measure and test window panel ideas.
12-30-31 - Build and test fit a window panel.
02-12-22 - Remove all windows, Build & Install window panels, Build Shelving. 
02-13-22 - Move the bus to house due to vendelism.
02-27-22 - Finish windows and shelving.  Remove graphics, stop signs and other items.  Bolts in floor where seats used to attach. 
03-26-22 - Pick up Freezers from Famous Tate.  Place in Bus. Test Power usage to calculate electrical needs.  More graphics removal. 
05-08-22 -  Cut the opening for the roll up door. Start painting the interiors.  
05-14-22 - Continue painting interiors and shelving.  Build wall seperating driver from storage.  
06-05-22 - Cut opening in roof for HVAC unit. Install unit.  Install electrical panel and run wiring for unit and exterior outlet connection.
06-11-22 - Exterior paint day!!!  Bus is brought to Messengers of Hope where it will stay through the rest of the build. More electrical work.  Battery installed.  
06-17-22 - Roll up door installed.  Awning installed.  Interior lighting installed.  
07-11-22 - Placing paper graphics to verify look of everything.  
07-12-22 - ABC Interview.
07-16-22 - Real graphics installed. 
07-17-22 - Official bus unveiling, Bus loaded, and taken to its first stop to serve the community.  
07-21-22 - BN9 Interview
07-22-22 - WQYK Interview
11-15-22 - Eagle Paperwork complete and turned in.
12-14-22 - Eagle BOR
